svg.title: VarMQ worker pool with concurrency 4
svg.desc: The queue starts empty. AddAll enqueues six jobs and signals the event loop. From that one signal the event loop dispatches four jobs back to back, one to each worker, until every slot is busy; the remaining two jobs wait in the queue. When Worker 2 finishes it signals the event loop, which dispatches the next job to it; when Worker 4 finishes the last job goes to Worker 4. Once the queue is empty, later completion signals find nothing to do and the event loop waits.
